text: Please help install the last war game on this Mac

For the actual execution of the task, did you record the specific execution as records so that we can look back and understand when and if you have performed each task

For records, how about you organize them by date, , then within each date setup folder structure by activity type, and under each activity type instance folder, write one execution as a record at a time?

I’ll start to ask you more tasks, and would want you to check if you have those in your system or not, if not, you shall create task types )separate folder from records, and note them, and you shall start to execute them and log the records.  Remember task types meta data folder and records do not need to be nested, task types meta data shall have its own top level folder.  If you already done the mentioned task types meta data, feel free to just do a check and and update meta data if appropriate, and skip execution and let future cycles does the execution.
